subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: Orientation and Multitasking
description: Learn Orientation and Multitasking in one minute.

hook.text: A user rotates the phone mid-form. The screen redraws and all the entered data disappears.

buildup.text: Rotating a device triggers a configuration change. On Android, the activity is destroyed and recreated.

discovery.text: Orientation tests verify layout adaptation, state preservation, and media continuity during rotation.

twist.text: Split-screen multitasking on tablets resizes the app dynamically. The UI must adapt to arbitrary sizes.

climax.text: Testing rotation during video playback finds the video restarts from the beginning. State saving fixes it.

punchline.text: Rotation destroys and rebuilds. Test that nothing is lost in between.

quiz.question: What happens on Android when the device is rotated?
options: The activity is destroyed and recreated
The app switches to landscape mode instantly
